paragraphs.text: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Monthly membership costs £29. Members can bring a friend free of charge once a month. Personal trainers are available at extra cost.
Indoor pool, sauna and gym, open 6 am to 10 pm. We offer annual membership only, from £420. Free parking for members. Children’s swimming lessons on Saturday mornings.
A small, friendly gym for women only, open 7 am to 9 pm. There is no joining fee, and yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price of £35.
Specialist equipment for weightlifting, open 8 am to 11 pm. Pay per visit (£6) or monthly (£40). Showers and lockers available. Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card.

A council-run centre with a gym, sports hall and running track, open 7 am to 10 pm. Monthly membership is £22, with reduced prices for people over 60. Introduction sessions for new members every Tuesday.

items.quote: with reduced prices for people over 60
items.prompt: offers cheaper prices for older people

explanation.en: “reduced prices for people over 60” → E. “Cheaper prices for older people” paraphrases this. The discount in D is for students.
explanation.kk: «reduced prices for people over 60» → E. «Cheaper prices for older people» осының басқаша айтылымы. D-дағы жеңілдік студенттерге арналған.
explanation.ru: «reduced prices for people over 60» → E. «Cheaper prices for older people» пересказывает это. Скидка в D — для студентов.

items.quote: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week
items.prompt: can be used at any time of the day or night

explanation.en: “Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week” → A. All the other gyms have fixed opening hours.
explanation.kk: «Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week» → A. Қалған залдардың бәрінің жұмыс уақыты бар.
explanation.ru: «Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week» → A. У всех остальных залов есть часы работы.

explanation.en: “We offer annual membership only” → B: only yearly membership, so no monthly option.
explanation.kk: «We offer annual membership only» → B: тек жылдық абонемент, айлап алуға болмайды.
explanation.ru: «We offer annual membership only» → B: только годовой абонемент, помесячно купить нельзя.

items.quote: Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card

explanation.en: Only PowerHouse Gym offers a student discount: “Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card” → D. Parkside’s discount is for people over 60.
explanation.kk: Студент жеңілдігі тек PowerHouse Gym-де бар: «Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card» → D. Parkside-та жеңілдік 60 жастан асқандарға.
explanation.ru: Скидка для студентов есть только у PowerHouse Gym: «Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card» → D. У Parkside скидка для людей старше 60.

items.quote: yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price of £35
items.prompt: includes some exercise classes in the membership price

explanation.en: “yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price” → C. Trainers in A are “at extra cost”, not included.
explanation.kk: «yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price» → C. A-дағы жеке бапкер — «at extra cost», бағаға кірмейді.
explanation.ru: «yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price» → C. Тренеры в A — «at extra cost», это не входит в цену.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five gyms, A–E. Which gym mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E.
